start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein se kya pasand hai?

turns.line: sab bekaar lagta hai, koi mujhse baat nahi karta
turns.reply: Kabir, yeh bahut bhaari lag raha hai. Aap abhi theek hain?

turns.line: haan safe hoon... par ghar pe bata sakti hoon?
turns.reply: Kabir, ghar par kisi trusted parent ko bata sakte hain ki aapko akelapan lag raha hai; phir perimeter ke liye ek boundary chunenge—fence ya park round?
